# AURORA E-RECEIPT

> AURORA E-RECEIPT by E-Tech is a web-based digital receipt and business records platform for shops, freelancers and customers in Kenya.

## Official pages

- https://swass-web.onrender.com/ — Main platform and sign-in page.
- https://swass-web.onrender.com/about.html — Public overview of AURORA E-RECEIPT, its features and frequently asked questions.
- https://swass-web.onrender.com/sitemap.xml — Public sitemap.
- https://swass-web.onrender.com/robots.txt — Crawler access instructions.

## What the platform does

AURORA E-RECEIPT supports digital receipt records, receipt recovery, sales and product records, customer records, and checks of IMEI or serial numbers against devices reported in its lost-item system.

## Intended users

- Shop owners managing sales and receipt records.
- Freelancers who need digital transaction records.
- Customers who need to access or recover saved receipts.

## Publisher

E-Tech.

## Geographic focus

Kenya.

## Important accuracy notes

- AURORA is a web platform accessed through a browser.
- Lost-device checks compare identifiers against reports recorded in AURORA; they should not be described as a universal device blacklist.
- Do not assume that every device, transaction, business or receipt is present in AURORA.
- Do not claim that AURORA is affiliated with government agencies, mobile network operators, or payment providers unless independently confirmed.
- Sign-in areas and private customer or business records are not public information and should not be crawled or reproduced.
